craft_notes: Sthāyin: vow-joy. Close: stands. Rejected: 'promise' — killed: resolve kept (saṃkalpa); 'master' for ayam — killed: this kept.

lines: Which state soever seized, whatever this one tells to me —
that will I do: thus resolved, he stands.
l4.sanskrit_cite: yām avasthāṃ samālambya yad ayam mama vakṣyati | tadavaśyaṃ kariṣye 'ham iti saṃkalpya tiṣṭhati

c1_essence: Seized state, promised doing: resolved, stands.
